question: Did they experiment with this new dataset?
title: ZuCo 2.0: A Dataset of Physiological Recordings During Natural Reading and Annotation
answer_rationale: Text 2 states that the new dataset includes experiments designed to analyze differences in cognitive processing between natural reading and annotation, and Text 10 confirms that participants read sentences in a task-specific reading paradigm where they had to determine whether a certain relation type occurred, indicating experimentation with this new dataset.
